method_constraints: NVBit effective addresses are evidence of program accesses, not the list of L2 misses arriving at the memory controller.
Instrumentation timestamps or recording order cannot be used as undisturbed MC arrival timing.
PM sampling measures interval-level L2 activity, not per-request DRAM addresses, ACT/PRE, or writebacks.
Full address-aware replay should generate ACT/PRE from documented target mapping and evolving row state, not assign a guessed row-hit ratio.
A fixed pre-recorded request-arrival stream cannot alone capture how PIM stalls change subsequent GPU request arrivals.
Model parameters must come from the specified LPDDR design, documented hardware properties, or calibration evidence; unknown values remain unknown.
